tailLossBehavior: The INITIAL OPEN barrier may be created once only for the persisted original request while the positive SQL account-control source remains at its exact captured NO_ACTIVE_ACCOUNT_WIDE_FLOW epoch. SQL records possible dispatch before the one-key call. Every retry after that point is read-only and requires exact original OPEN readback plus protected incarnation observation. A missing key after a possible dispatch is reset or unknown-outcome evidence and remains non-admitting; it is never a fresh OPEN source. Every existing key, including CLOSED, newer, malformed, expiring, or conflicting values, is refused without mutation. This local proof does not supply Account lease/currentness, issuer or region acknowledgements, final binding CAS, or gameplay admission.
